title: Plan the holiday together

scenario.en: You and two friends are going to travel in July. The group needs a clear plan.
scenario.ar: انت وصاحبينك هتسافروا في يوليو. المجموعة محتاجة خطة واضحة.

source: Mona says: 'We are going to travel in July.' Youssef says: 'I am going to save money, but I can't book the hotel.' The group needs a plan: who is going to book the flight, who is going to choose the hotel, and how much everyone is going to save.

task.en: Organise the plan: ask who will do each job, react to Youssef, and agree how much to save.
task.ar: نظّم الخطة: اسأل مين هيعمل إيه، رد على يوسف، واتفقوا على مبلغ التوفير.

key_points.en: Ask who is going to book the flight.
Ask who is going to choose the hotel.
React to Youssef: he can save but can't book.
key_points.ar: رد على يوسف: يقدر يوفّر بس مش هيحجز.

key_points.en: Agree how much everyone is going to save.

model_answer.en: Mona, are you going to book the flight? Youssef, you can save money, so I am going to choose the hotel. How much is everyone going to save each week?
model_answer.ar: منى، انتي هتحجزي الطيران؟ يوسف، انت هتوفّر فلوس، فأنا هختار الفندق. كل واحد هيوفّر كام في الأسبوع؟
